open.title: Prove that Json.parse accepts every JSON text of its grammar
open.contract:
- Prove completeness over the executed parser in `lean/Acorn/Json.lean` beside `parse_sound`: `∀ text v, Grammar.Text text.toList v → Json.parse text = .ok v`.
- In `lean/Acorn/Decisions.lean`, replace the two one-way kinds (`json_parse` and `json_parse_text`) with the two-way kind `Regula.Decides (·.isOk = true) (fun text => ∃ v, Grammar.Text text.toList v)`, and give `control_command` the two-way kind over `Host.Viewer.ControlSpelled`.
- Verify that `./scripts/verify.sh` and `./scripts/lean.sh lint` (`./scripts/gate.sh`) pass on the exact head.

open.contract:
- In `lean/Acorn/Host/Microduck/Action.lean` and `lean/Acorn/Host/Microduck/Bridge.lean`, make the posture duration a function of the action and the stated posture (`sitting`): zero when the release sends no skill and the declared duration otherwise, with `Bridge.next` keeping its signature and passing the `sitting` its record holds.
